label: agent loop • a successful side effect followed by final prose stops exactly once despite a pending todo
query: Use the todo tool to track exactly these two items: (1) write receipt.txt containing exactly REMINDER_CREATED, and (2) optional future review. Complete item 1 now by calling file_write with the relative path receipt.txt. Leave the optional future review unchecked, report REMINDER_CREATED to me once, and stop.
notes: Regression for the Qwen/Ornith reminder loop: a successful side effect was followed by valid final prose, but an unchecked Todo kept the run alive and the model repeated the same confirmation. Todo is display/progress state, never a control-flow owner. The six-step ceiling allows benign pre-final planning or verification differences while still failing the old behavior, which reopened the run until the ten-step safety cap.
